templates.name: Straight Tunnel Niche
notes: Three-wide approach: columns 3..5 are exactly 3-wide for rows 2..4 behind the W door band.
Corridor bellies to 5-wide (rows 1..5) in columns 6..8 before narrowing again.
Rim sealed with rock except at door band; no ore hints in this stamp.

templates.name: Crystal Belly (Small)
notes: Three-row throat: rows 1..3 are exactly 3-wide under the N door band.
Oval-ish belly opens to ~9x7 with small rock pillars that avoid the approach lane.
Rim rock everywhere except door lane; no ore hints here (CA/erosion handles edges).

templates.name: Veined Chamber
notes: E-side three-wide door band is 3 tiles deep (cols 10..12) with a strict 3-wide approach at cols 7..9 for rows 3..5.
Ore-pref cells clustered along the western chamber wall, avoiding the approach and ≥2 tiles from rim.
O-cells are on rock only; chamber compact and rotation-safe.
